Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 



SPECIFICATION FOR 
SCRAPERS USED IN MINES 



1. Scope — Covers thB requirements for scrapers used in mines for loading loosend rock onto 
conveyor system. 

2. Grades 

2.1 Light Grade — Suitable for rocl^ of bulk density less than 2 t/m^ and having ratio of 2*5 or more 
between the width of scraper and the maximum size of rock to be handled by the scraper. 

2.2 Heavy Grad^ — Suitable for rock of bulk densWy more than 2 t/m' and having a ratio of less 
than 2'5 between the width of scraper and maximum size of rock to be handled by the scraper. 

3. Types, Main Parameters and Dintensions — As specified in Table 1. 

4. Designation —A light grade paddle type scraper of rigid, multi-sectional construction with a 
theoretical capacity of I'OO m^ shall be designated as: 

Scraper, Light/PRM 100 IS : 10202 

Note — Letters 'P* B' and *5' shall be employed to indicate paddle, box and scoop type scrapers and letters 
'/?* and 'A' shal) be used to indicate rigid and articulated construction. Letter *M' shall be used only if mutti- 
sectionat construction is-^desired. 

5. General Requirements 

5s1 The design of the scraper shall ensure quick assembling or dismantling under actual mining 
conditions. 

5.2 The design of scraper shall permit rapid changing of the detachable cutting edges, it used, 
under actual mining conditions. 

5.3 The detachable cutting edges, if used, shall be manufactured from wear resistant steel 
conforming to IS: 1570-1961 "Schedules for wrought steels for general engineering purposes'. 

5.4 Before assembling, the seating surfaces of the components of the scrapers shall be cleaned. 

5.5 Scrapers shall be supplied in assembled conditions. Scrapers of capacity greater than 0'4 m* 
may be supplied in dismantled condition, if required by purchaser. 

5.6 An instruction manual shall be supplied with each scraper which shall lay down the Instruc- 
tions for use, proper maintenance, spare parts lists and other relevant information. 

6. Marking — Each scraper shall be marked with manufacturer's Jiame or trade-mark or Identifica- 
tion mark, year and month of manufacture and the designatioh of the scraper. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the fndian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE

7-1966 'Scrapers for underground mining', issued by the USSR State Committee of Standards,
